name: The Rent Is Too Damn High
look: Jimmy McMillan, with bushy white mutton chops, a mustache and glasses, raises a black-gloved fist high as he speaks. He wears a black suit and a black and white patterned tie in front of a blue curtain.
use: Complains that something costs too much or is simply excessive. The top caption names the thing and the bottom caption declares it "is too damn high," echoing McMillan's fiery campaign slogan about rent.
slots: top caption: the thing that is excessive
examples: The number of streaming services I pay for
describe: old man with white sideburns raising his fist in black gloves
man with mutton chops and glasses shouting about rent
angry guy with a gray beard fist in the air at a debate
man in black gloves and a suit protesting prices
bearded politician raising his fist in front of a blue curtain
origin: Jimmy McMillan, founder of the Rent Is Too Damn High Party, during his 2010 run for governor of New York.
